LUNAR LEGACY – Meet the Team Leader

I am Debanshi Saipriya, a B.Tech Computer Science student specialising in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, with a curiosity about space, science, technology, and the stories behind human exploration. I enjoy learning how things work, asking questions, researching topics, and turning ideas into projects. I believe innovation begins with curiosity, but it becomes valuable when people work together to transform that curiosity into something others
